updateGroups.label: Node's types are held at the Node that CI runs and `engines.node` names (22), so a type for an API the runner does not have fails the type-check. version-sync keeps the three together. To move: change `engines.node` in the root's package.json, then `bun run version-sync` names every workflow and every @types/node to change; write @types/node at the newest of that major (`bun info @types/node@<major> version`), `bun install`, and fix what the type-check finds

The Effect language service: a new version adds diagnostics the profile in tsconfig.base.json must name, and patches only the typescript, tsrs and oxlint versions it lists. Moved by hand, with them. To move: write the new @effect/tsgo in the package.json files that name it and run `bun install`, which stops and names the typescript, tsrs and oxlint versions it supports; write those, name any new diagnostic in tsconfig.base.json and the packages' own profiles, then `bun run check:full`
Patched by @effect/tsgo at install (the root's prepare script), which stops on a version it does not list. They move only with @effect/tsgo

A beta pinned as one set to one commit of its library and kept as files (vendor/alchemy). Re-pinned together, never one package at a time from the registry. To move: `bun run alchemy:repin -- main` moves the pin to the head of the library's main (a commit's first seven characters in place of main for that commit): it replaces the files, the overrides and the version each package.json asks for, installs, checks the pin and runs the full check, and commits nothing. `bun run alchemy:check` checks the pin as it is

Its tables are a migration written by hand (docs/auth.md), and a new version can want a table or a column they do not make: `bun run check` fails then (test/server/AuthSchema.test.ts). To move: write the new version in the package.json files that name it, `bun install`, `bun run auth:schema`, save what it prints as the next migration (nothing printed, nothing to save), then `bun run check`

SheetJS publishes at its own address, and the registry's xlsx stopped at 0.18.5. Written as an address and moved by hand. To move: change the address in packages/foundation/modeling/xlsx/package.json to the new file on cdn.sheetjs.com, then `bun install`

versionGroups.label: An override names a kept package's file, not a version: version-sync holds each to vendor/alchemy/sources.json

A dependency the root's catalog names is asked for as `catalog:` in every package.json, so its version is written once, in the root's package.json. `bun run config-sync` writes this list from the catalog

semverGroups.label: Effect packages move together and are pinned to one exact version
